summary: Atlas review polish: 409/500 error split on atlas route + length-targeted exemplar selection
description: From PR review. (1) atlas route maps ALL generator errors to 409; split known refusals (dup in-flight, thin corpus) -> 409 via a typed AtlasRefusal, unexpected/transient (empty completion, LLM/network, insert) -> 500. (2) exemplar/contrast selection ordered by shortest (token_count ASC), picking least-substantive passages; reorder by distance from a target combined length so citations are concise but representative.
